scope.purpose: Move through a long list or table split into numbered pages.
useCases: Paging through a table of results.
exclusions: A page-size selector and a 'Page x of y' text (composition examples).
A compact mobile variant in v1.
Cursor-based paging without a page count (previous and next Buttons).
alternatives: A Load more Button or infinite scrolling for feeds read in order.

examples.preview: dist/previews/pagination.html (npm run build && npm run build:preview pagination)

contract.scope: Pagination compound contract: bindable page, pageCount, siblingCount, href with {page}, size, label, previousLabel, nextLabel; children item (color.item, current page with an indicator edge) and ellipsis; constant item count; IconButton previous and next.

decisionsTaken: Pages are items painted with color.item.* (selected for the current page, with a 1 px inner edge in color.item.indicator so that the current page is not conveyed by the tint alone); square boxes of size.control.{size}, radius.control, typography.numeral.{size} (tabular figures).
Previous and next are IconButtons (neutral ghost, pagination's size) with intrinsic chevrons; they stay in place when disabled at the bounds.
Constant item count (siblingCount × 2 + 5): first, last, current and siblings, ellipses for gaps of two pages or more, so that the controls do not move while paging (the usual algorithm).
href with a {page} placeholder turns every control into a link; otherwise buttons and pageChange.
No roving focus: each control is a tab stop (WAI-ARIA has no pagination pattern; links in a navigation landmark).

Contract fact found during implementation: typography.numeral.{size} became typography.label.{size} (numeral.lg is 24 px), with tabular figures set by the component. Recorded in pendingChanges for the implementation gate.
Round 2: showEdges adds first and last IconButtons (Phosphor caret-double glyphs), disabled at the ends and staying in place.
nextAction: Figma parity (skill ggb-figma), grouped with the rest of wave 4 once Tabs, Breadcrumb and Toolbar pass round 3.
implementationNotes: The item algorithm lives in pages.ts with a unit test (tests/pagination-entries.test.ts) over every page of counts 1 to 40 and siblings 0 to 3.
Previous and next reset the ButtonGroup size context (their size is the pagination size).
